APPROVE

The merged guard keeps the same short-circuit order, and `DisabledEntryKey` returns null in exactly the cases where the original `continue`d, so behaviour is preserved. Removing the nested `if`s should bring the complexity well under 15, and the `string?` return with a null check is nullable-clean. One caveat: the diff elides the unchanged lines after the extraction (the marker-adding code), so I assumed they use only `key` and `parsed[i]`. If they used `entry`, the build would break.
